tei:div.tei:p: shangs pa bka' brgyud rin chen bdun byon tshul bzhugs so/ /

na mo ratna gu ru/ zab don thar lam nye ba mkha' 'gro'i chos/ /sgyu lus rm-i lam sprul sgyur dbang 'byor zhing*/ /chos skyong mgon po'i 'phrin las legs bsgrubs pa/ /shangs pa bka' rgyud byon tshul zur tsam 'bri/ /de'ang shangs pa'i chos skor zhes bya ba/ rgyud thag nye zhing*/ rgyud pa bka' babs dang ldan pa/ gdams ngag nus pa dang ldan pa/ mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ 'di'i byung tshul bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar zur tsam bstan pa ni/ thog mar sangs rgyas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma dang*/ su ga siddhi la gsungs shing*/ de gnyis kyi zhal dngos su bstan nas gsung ba ni/ mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor gyi 'khrung yul ni/ snye mo ra mangs/ rigs ni bon po/ rus ni khyung po/ yab khyung po stag skyes dang*/ yum bkra shis skyid kyi sras su 'khrungs ma thag tu/ grub thob a mo gha pas lung bstan/ yig rtsis la sogs mkhas par mkhyen/ bon dang*/ phyag rgya chen po zhus pa la the tshom re tsam 'khrungs nas/ rgya gar la chos 'tshol du byon/ paṇḍi ta ma thu badzra dang*/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i drung du mjal/ ma ga dhar dge tshul zhus/ mtshan tshul khrims mgon por btags pas/ bla mas shangs khrag shor nas/ khyung po rnal 'byor la mtshan dpod ma thub/ de nas bzung ste spyir rgya gar dang bal por theng bdun byon zhing*/ rje btsun shrī dzñā na dang*/ bai ro tsa na rakṣi ta la sogs pa/ khyad par can gyi bla ma brgya lnga bcu dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam bzhi/ 'gran gyi zla med ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma/ zhal gnyis rnams/ mos gus dang gser srang mang pos mnyes par byas nas gang la gang 'dod kyi zab chos/ bka' lung man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnang zhing*/ khyad par du rgyal sras mi tri pa dang*/ dpal sha ba ri pas chos skyong phyag drug pa'i skor tshang ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro rnam gnyis kyis byin gyis brlabs/ gsang yum mdzad/

chos drug gi khrid tshang ma gnang*/ khyod nas mi rabs lnga'i bar la chig rgyud las ma spel cig gsungs/ bka' rgya bsdams/ chos kyi mnga' bdag chen por gyur nas/ bod la byon/ mnga' ris su jo bo rje dang mjal/ gdams pa zhus/ glang ri thang pa'i drung du bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ 'jog po'i ri la sgrub pa mdzad/ cha dkar dgon pa btab/ mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung nas/ dpon slob sum stong gi yan byon/ shangs su zhong zhong dgon pas 'go byas/ gnas dgon brgya rtsa btab/ grwa slob mang dus khri tsho bdun brgyad 'tshogs/ de thams cad chos kyis tshim par mdzad/ de skabs ḍā ki ma kun tu bzang mo byon nas/ tshogs pa'i mthar thug khri tsho brgyad/ /slob ma'i mthar thug lnga brgya dang*/ /tshe yi mthar thug brgya lnga bcu/ /zhing khams mthar thug bde ba can/ /zhes gsungs pa de rnams 'dzoms shing dus la babs par mkhyen nas/ slob ma'i thuu bo rmi'u ston pa dang*/ g.yor po rgya mo che sngul ston rin dbang*/ zhang sgom chos seng*/ las stod pa dkon mchog mkhar dang lnga/ chig rgyud kyi bka' babs pa/ rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ rnams kyis thog drangs pa'i/ grwa slob dbu che ba rnams la chos kyi phy-i ma gsungs/ chos rgyud dar zhing rgyas par yong cing*/ nga'i phung po 'di ril bur gzhug su bcug nas/ gsol ba btab na/ gnas zhong zhong 'di rdo rje gdan dang mnyam pa zhig yong ngo*/ /gsungs pa la sogs kyi lung bstan mang po mdzad nas/ bde ba can du gshegs so/ /de'i thugs kyi sras mchog rmog cog pa rin chen brtson 'grus ni/ 'khrungs yul lha phug spangs rtsa ba/ rus she yab shor rgan sman chung dang*/ yum 'be mo padma sgron gyi sras su 'khrungs te/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa la/ mkhas grub khyung po'i drung du rab tu byung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas slob gnyer cig sngon la gyis gsungs nas/ blau mos dang*/ dmigs rkyen sgrub pa la che bar byung nas/

slob dpon la ching ba dang*/ grub thob khams pa a seng*/ bur sgom nag po/ dge bshes dkon mchog mkhar pa la sogs/ mkhas grub mang po la/ sgom 'khrid zhus/ slar zhong zhong bla ma'i drung du byon nas/ nyams rtogs re tsam phul bas/ sngon ma bla mas bkyon par byung na'ang*/ rting du nga'i chig rgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo 'di/ khyod la byin gsungs pa ḍā ki ma'i lung bstan yin gsungs nas/ bum pa gang byo gnang*/ ne gu'i thugs dam thang sku/ dgyes rdor gyi thang sku/ ka pa li dang*/ thod pa mtshan ldan/ dbang bum dang bcas pa gnang*/ rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgoms pas/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs/ sprul sgyur la dbang thob/ chos skyong bran bzhin nyan/ gnas chen dang yi dam mang po'i zhal gzigs/ rje dwags po lha rje sogs dang mjal/ byin rlabs zhus/ rmog cog gi brag la lo bcu gnyis kyi bar la lto gos 'phri ba bcad nas/ rtse gcig tu sgrub pa mdzad/ zad sar gyi sprul sgyur/ nam mkha' la skyil krung du bzhugs/ slob ma mkhas pa dran don/ dbus pa rdo seng la sogs pa mang du byung zhing*/ de rnams kyi nang nas/ chig rgyud kyi gdams pa dbon ston skyer sgang pa la phog grwa slob mang nas rmog cog tu ma shong bar/ skung lung dgon pa btab/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ bde ba can du gdan 'dren byung na'ang ma byon par/ der rting lo gsum gyi bar la chos gsungs nas/ nga 'das pa dang mngon dgar gsol ba thob gsungs nas/ tshes bco brgyad kyi srod la/ 'gro rus btsan gyi snyon dris/ lan gnang*/ tho rangs bde bar gshegs so/ /de'i thugs sras dam pa skyer sgang pa/ dbon ston thugs rje chen po ni/ 'khrungs yul nang gong rnams pa/ rus pa 'bal/ dgung lo bcu bdun la/ khu bo 'bal thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du rab tu byung*/ mtshan chos kyi seng ge btags/ des gdan sa byed dgos pas/

thos pa gyis zer na'ang*/ lha sa'i brag lha klu phug tu lce sgom rdzong pa la/ thugs rje chen po'i chos skor zhus/ rtse gcig sgrub pas/ zla ba phyed dang bzhi nas/ gtso 'khor gsum po zhal mthong*/ bla ma tsa ri ras pa dang*/ rtogs ldan zhang la sogs/ bla ma mang du bsten/ rm-i lam bzung nas/ blo dpon padma la sogs rgya bod kyi grub chen rnams la chos zhus/ yi dam mkha' 'gro mang po'i zhal mthong*/ zhing khams gnas chen mang du bstan/ bha ru nas sbyin bdag byas/ smyon pa brgyad cu btul/ mchog tu sku drin che bas/ bla ma rmog cog pas/ mkha' 'gro'i zab chos chig rgyud kyi thog drangs pa'i/ gdams pa thams cad ma lus par/ dbus snyung bzhes nas gnang*/ chos skyong dran bzhin nyan pa'i bka' bsgau mdzad/ byin gyis brlabs sku drin dran pa'i 'bul mo che thengs gsum phul/ bla ma skyer sgang du byon dus/ nyams bsdur mdzad pas/ mnyes nas dbon ston/ pa la mdzo skyes zer ba'i skad thongs shig gsung zhing*/ sngar rgya gar gyi grub thob phal che ba las/ mkhas grub khyung po thugs dam bzang bar 'dug de las nga dge sbyor bzang bar 'dug gsung zhing yod/ nga las khyed nyams rtogs bzang bar 'dug go /ngo mtshar che gsungs ngo*/ /grwa slob yon bdag ni/ rgya thang rgya'i rgyal po/ bla ma sog pa/ dkar chung btsad po/ rgyal tsha la sogs/ skya btsun mang po chos kyi tshim zhing*/ nad gdon las grol nas/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal mthong ba sha stag byung ngo*/ /chos rgyud 'di/ g.yor po stod pa zhig gis 'dzin cing*/ rdo rje 'chang gis lung bstan pa bzhin/ brgyud pa bdun thims nas/ chig rgyud kyi zab chos/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal gdams 'dis/ phyogs kun du khyab nas/ gdul bya snod ldan yang*/ mang du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nga ni 'di nas mngon dgar 'gro bas/ gsol ba der thob cig gsungs pa la sogs lung bstan mang du gnang zhing*/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba mang po'i don rgya che la yun ring bar mdzad nas/

dgung lo don gsum bzhes pa/ ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu gsum la/ skyer sgang du bde bar gshegs so/ / yol bu ri gong gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'khrungs yul yol bu'i mda'/ rus gnyan de nyid ni/ sku gzhon nu nas/ chos kho na'i gtam dang*/ spyod lam la brtson pa zhig byung ste/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la gung po mkhar du/ slob dpon ston yes la/ chos sgor zhugs/ bcu bdun pa la/ mkhan po byang sems pa la dge tshul zhus/ mtshan chos kyi shes rab tu btags/ nyi shu pa la mkhan po bzod pa'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ g.yor slob dpon e pa sogs la/ 'dul ba bslabs/ slob gnyer thog cig byed dgos dgongs pa la/ mched grogs las stod 'khyams pos blo sgul nas/ sgom sgrub pa la mos te/ skyer sgang du byon/ dbon ston pas shangs pa'i chos skor dang*/ chig rgyud kyi gdams pa zab mo thams cad bum pa gang byo gnang*/ chos skyong la bka' bsgo dang*/ ri gong dgon pa 'debs pa/ skabs 'di tsam nas spyod pa'i tshul bzung*/ slob ma snod ldan bcu phrag cig yod pa de/ skye bo 'bum phrag cig las lhag go gsungs pa la sogs kyi lung bstan mdzad/ bla ma dang nam mjal dus/ thugs rje chen por rgyun par mthong*/ bla ma las stod pa mgon po chos sgo skyel la byung*/ rm-i lam bzung nas/ yi dam dang zhing khams mang po mthong*/ khyad par grub chen brgyad cu la sogs/ ḍā ki ma mang po 'dzoms nas/ chos kyi bzang bdun mdzad par byon/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i skal ba gsol/ lha klu bdud btsan mang po btul/ bla ma 'dis dus gsum gyi skye 'gag gnas gsum mkhyen na'ang*/ blo dman gyi blor mi shong bas/ log rtog gi rgyur song dogs bka' rgya bsdams pas na/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor chen por grags zhing*/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs nas/ 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad do/ /bde bar gshegs dus/ nga ni 'di nas shar phyogs me tog bkram pa'i zhing du/

sangs rgyas padmo'i dpal zhes par 'gyur bas/ gsol ba der thob cig gsungs so/ /brag dgon pa ba chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa ni/ 'khrungs yul kha rag sil ma/ rus ya ngal dkar po/ rigs bon po yin na'ang*/ bon la thugs ma song*/ gzhon nu nas/ mi rtag pa kho na rgyud la skye ba byung zhing*/ dgung lo bcu pa la sprul sku'i dbang bskur lung bstan/ bcu gsum pa la bla ma tsā ri ras pa la rab tu byung*/ mtshan brtson 'grus seng ger btags/ slob dpon sdigs [ sregs ] dang*/ sum pa ras pa/ bla ma sa skya pa/ bla ma khro phu pa la sogs/ mkhas grub mang du bsten/ gdams pa dpag med zhus/ bcu dgu pa la/ slob dpon chos rgyal ba la bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ der rting slob dpon rngaug ston gyi lung bstan pa bzhin yol bu ri gong du byon pas/ bla ma gnyan ston mnyes nas/ dbang bskur shangs pa'i chos skor thams cad/ chig rgyud kyi gdams pa dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo dbus snyung bzhes nas gnang*/ chos skyong lcam dral la mi lab pa bzhin du ngo sprad/ bka' bsgo mdzad/ de nas chos drug gi 'khrid bskyangs pas/ zhag nyi shu rtsa lnga la/ sprul sgyur sbyongs spel thub pa byung bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ sngar rgya gar gyi grub thob rnams las/ bla ma khyung po nyams rtaugs bzang bar grags/ de las rim gyi bzang du song zer/ nga las ni khyed dge sbyor bzang bar 'dug pa/ 'di 'dra'i dge sbyor skye lugs da lta rgya bod gang na'ang med/ khyed kyi 'gro don rgya chen po 'grub pa 'dug gsungs shing*/ lung bstan zhal gdams mang po gnang ngo*/ /de ltar bsgoms pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mang po'i zhal mthong*/ chos gnang*/ brag dgon du lo gcig dbu sngas la ma bzhag par sgom pas zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin rnams rgya chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas zhing khams gang mos su/ rmi lam bzung nas phyin chog pa byung*/ gnod byed mang po rmi lam du btul/

chos skyong 'khor la sdig ma gsog zer ba'i kha mnan gang thub byas/ sman lung su snyung nas grongs la thug pa'i dus/ tsha drags brag ring gi btsan gyi/ bal yul nas sman blangs nas phul ba dang*/ thugs dam rtse gcig mdzad pas/ snyung ba las grol cing*/ sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad do/ /bla ma 'di'i rjes la/ chig rgyud kyi bka' rgya khrol te/ khong gi slob ma chos rje shangs ston dang*/ mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub la sogs/ mkhas grub mang du byon cing*/ slob ma'i mchog grub thob brgya rtsa brgyad grags pas/ chos rgyud nyin mo ltar phyogs kun du gsal la/ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa lags so/ /rgyud pa rin chen bdun ma 'di bris pas/ /dge tshogs rin chen phyogs bcu kun khyab ste/ dal 'byor rin chen thob pa'i mi rnams dang*/ 'gro kun rin chen brtson 'grus nyid gyur cig/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/shangs pa bka' brgyud rin chen bdun byon tshul/ -PAGE 276--PAGE 277--PAGE 274-
